recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17322 unless FHIR-I later revisits the separate generic OPTIONS behavior note covered by FHIR-17831.
issue_request: FHIR-17322 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive, asking R4 to remove the deprecated STU3 use of HTTP OPTIONS for retrieving the server CapabilityStatement because that use was not conformant with HTTP and complicated CORS support.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in svn revision 13874, mirrored as commit 996a1f3590fd9b32e1883f47b977b26a3e98234b, which removed the remaining commented hData/OPTIONS service-URL text from source/http.html. Earlier commit f74048dde73667db9350d52f87f4e55bff46dcd6 had changed the conformance interaction to GET and marked OPTIONS deprecated.
additional_context: source/http.html is the active RESTful API HTTP narrative linked from source/documentation.html. Its current capabilities section and summary tables define GET /metadata returning CapabilityStatement, while the remaining OPTIONS mentions are a later generic FHIR-17831 HTTP-capabilities note, DICOM Endpoint examples, and historical release notes. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope HTTP source already satisfies FHIR-17322 by using GET /metadata rather than OPTIONS [base] to retrieve the server CapabilityStatement.

related_jiras.note: Added the current generic note about unspecified HTTP capabilities such as OPTIONS; it explains the only current source/http.html OPTIONS mention and was already audited on the combined branch.
A separate Published cleanup removed OPTIONS wording from the capability-statement-kind value set; it was only historical context for this HTTP-page issue.
